## What's new

### Your words, shortcuts and email addresses
- **Add your own words.** Search for a word in **Learned words** and tap **Add**. It's suggested and works with glide typing straight away, and it's never autocorrected away.
- **Text shortcuts.** In **Shortcuts**, set a word to stand for any text, like "omw" for "on my way". Type the shortcut and its text shows in the middle of the suggestion strip; tap it to use it. Space keeps what you typed.
- **Your email addresses.** The keyboard remembers addresses you type, in email fields or when you finish one with space or enter, and how often you use each. Email fields offer them as soon as they open, most used first. Elsewhere, typing the first 4 letters of one offers it beside your word, and from 7 letters every matching address fills the strip. They're listed in **Learned words**, where you can delete them or add one yourself.

### Faster editing
- **Slide left from backspace** to delete whole words: each step back takes one more word, slide back to keep some, and lift to delete. The undo pill brings them back.
- **A pop-up of the pressed letter** shows above your finger, so you can see what you hit.
- Both slides (space and backspace) and the pop-up can be turned off under **Typing**.

### Make it yours
- **Accent colours:** Moon blue, emerald, amber, cyan, coral or violet, or take every colour from your wallpaper (Material You, Android 12 and newer). The settings app follows the accent too.
- **Pitch black** for dark mode, for OLED screens.
- The app's home screen shows the keyboard's icon beside its name.

### Privacy
- **Incognito button:** add it to the top bar (or use it from the options panel) and nothing you type is learned, in any app, until you turn it off.

### Typing
- Sloppy taps and fast glides come out right more often while the smarter predictions are on (in testing: about 89% → 93% of quickly tapped English words, 84% → 90% in Hinglish, and 81% → 84% of fast English glides).
- The suggestion strip no longer flashes the toolbar when you start typing after the undo pill shows.
- Emoji suggestions are set apart by dividers, and the line under the strip runs edge to edge.
